research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Kiwi Biosciences is engaged in developing food supplement compositions to aid in digestion of fructan, mannitol, and related compounds, as described in the title 'Food supplement composition to aid in digestion of fructan, mannitol, and …'. The abstract details technology focused on combinations for reducing symptoms of digestive conditions, particularly those caused by ingestion of FODMAPs. These efforts highlight research and development in enzyme-based solutions for digestive health.
